verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly publishes a pricing page that shows a $0/mo free tier and says seats are unlimited because "pricing is based on usage". It also defines some metered units, such as AI Runs for tracked LLM requests and evals, and 5K session replays and 5K errors per month. A community report adds that client-side usage is charged by MAU. The evidence does not show paid-tier prices or a first-party explanation of the core usage meter, so a PM can only partly understand what drives cost. Missing for 10: published paid-tier price points, a first-party definition of the primary flag usage metric (MAU or connections) and its rates, overage or tier thresholds, and independent confirmation that the pricing is clear.
